title: [CQ-V01c] Candidate protectedEntries record (review slice of landed dc13b0e)
definitionOfDone: Candidate.protectedEntries is optional and is recorded exactly as reported. Entries have normalized project-relative paths and lowercase 40-hex oids, are strictly ascending by UTF-8 bytes with no duplicates, and number at most 2000. Absent means not measured; [] means nothing exists under the protected paths.
Malformed protectedEntries are refused with INVALID_INPUT naming the offending entry, and nothing is written.

protectedEntries are part of the immutable candidate. A same-id re-record with different entries, absent vs [] included, is refused as CANDIDATE_IMMUTABLE; an identical re-record is idempotent; readers hand out deep copies.
moe.record_candidate accepts protectedEntries under the same rules, and the held-out acceptance payload (which has no protectedEntries) records unchanged.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
Review slice of already-landed bytes: never re-implement, revert or re-land; edit only for a QA-required defect, within 400 net LOC.

implementationPlan.description:
Phase 0: confirm the review scope. Expect NO edits.
- This row owns 5 files of dc13b0e, +147/-6, 141 net:
  - types/schema.ts +6
  - state/candidateStore.ts +53/-5
  - state/candidateStore.test.ts +60/-1
  - tools/recordCandidate.ts +11
  - tools/recordCandidate.test.ts +17
- CQ-V01 (task-bde86540) owns the other 4 files of that commit (see its task comment). Never touch them.
- Confirm the 5 files carry no uncommitted bytes: `git diff --quiet HEAD -- <the 5 files>`.
- List the commits since dc13b0e that touched them (`git log --oneline dc13b0e..HEAD -- <files>`; F08 changed schema.ts). Step 2 proves the behaviour still holds on HEAD.
- Do NOT re-implement, revert or re-land (task rail). Edit only if one of these tests is red at HEAD. Then make the minimal fix inside the 5 files (error handling and test intent unchanged) and keep the row at 400 net or less.

Verification gate, run once.
- Exact command: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test`, plus `npx tsc --noEmit`. Run both in the isolated Linux snapshot with MOE_* unset.
- Both must exit 0, and the fresh test output tail is the complete_task verification evidence.
- SIZE: record `git show --numstat --format= dc13b0e -- <the 5 files>`. The expected total is +147/-6, 141 net, plus anything step 2 had to add. It must be at most 400.

Adversarial self-review of the 5 files at HEAD. Load adversarial-self-review first.

Attack the code:
- Can a path escape the project, carry a control character, or arrive unnormalized and still be stored?
- Can absent and [] ever compare equal?
- Can a reader mutate stored entries?
- Does the held-out record_candidate payload store a protectedEntries key it never sent?
- Error handling: does every refusal name its field index and write nothing?

Then call complete_task with a summary under 2000 chars that:
- maps the 5 files and their numstat;
- lists DoD to test and the six mutation results;
- states that no bytes changed, or names the minimal assertion added.

planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- candidateStore.ts holds the rules:
  - readProtectedEntries: absent stays absent; strict {path, oid} objects; normalizeAffectedFile with a must-already-be-normalized check; a control-character refusal; BLOB_OID_RE /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/; strictly ascending by Buffer.compare; MAX_PROTECTED_ENTRIES 2000.
  - replayOrRefuse compares JSON.stringify(stored ?? null), so absent never equals [].
  - copy deep-maps the entries.
- recordCandidate.ts inputSchema: protectedEntries is an array with maxItems 2000 and closed items, and is not required.
- Later commits touched schema.ts (F08 StepCompletionEvidence). The V01c bytes are unaffected.
